02 / THE STUDIO

A direct line

Orvanta Labs is a founder-led AI engineering practice based in Pakistan, working with businesses and agencies on focused implementation projects.

SHAKEEL UR REHMAN / FOUNDER

From understanding
to implementation.

I’m Shakeel Ur Rehman, a Computer Science graduate from UET Lahore. My work spans computer vision, applied machine learning, and agentic AI, with an emphasis on connecting models to usable applications.

My public engineering work explores object detection and tracking, explainable prediction, and multi-agent systems. The approach is practical: understand the data, evaluate the model, and make its behavior inspectable.

03 / HOW WE WORK

Small first.
Useful from the start.

A focused pilot gives you something to evaluate before committing to a wider rollout.

01 / DISCOVER

Find the friction.

Understand the workflow, available data, and what a successful result would look like.

02 / SCOPE

Agree on a pilot.

Define deliverables, exclusions, evaluation criteria, cost, and timeline before building.

03 / BUILD & EVALUATE

Make it tangible.

Review a working pilot together. Test real scenarios, edge cases, and failure handling.

04 / HAND OVER

Keep you in control.

Receive the agreed source code, documentation, and a clear plan for hosting and maintenance.
